staff_conversations_direct_key_check.name: staff_conversations_direct_key_check

staff_messages_body_check.name: staff_messages_body_check
staff_messages_body_check.value: "staff_messages"."deleted_at" is not null or "staff_messages"."kind" <> 'text' or "staff_messages"."body" is not null

operating_sites_origin_coordinates_check.name: operating_sites_origin_coordinates_check
operating_sites_origin_coordinates_check.value: ("operating_sites"."origin_latitude" is null and "operating_sites"."origin_longitude" is null) or ("operating_sites"."origin_latitude" between -90 and 90 and "operating_sites"."origin_longitude" between -180 and 180)

customer_addresses_coordinates_check.name: customer_addresses_coordinates_check
customer_addresses_coordinates_check.value: ("customer_addresses"."latitude" is null and "customer_addresses"."longitude" is null) or ("customer_addresses"."latitude" between -90 and 90 and "customer_addresses"."longitude" between -180 and 180)
